taken: feat/public-surfaces-p1-shell (card P1, view mode): main.ts split into the view path (index, plus the shared panels and preload-helper chunks it imports) and lazy chunks — the compiler (its own `compiler` chunk, modulepreloaded, not render-blocking), the example sources, the header actions, edit mode (CodeMirror and the source panels), takeoff and the 3D preview. The view path went from 625,306 B (index 192,918 + panels 432,388, the core inside panels) to 9,276 B; the compiler alone is 429,704 B. No 3D marker and no CodeMirror marker in any startup chunk.
how: npm ci && npm run build && npm run playground:build:only; each size is the byte length of node:zlib gzipSync(file) at the default level, keyed by the file name without its content hash (for reading only: the gates sum them). The startup set is walked (card PG5a): the files dist/index.html names (its module <script src> and every <link rel=modulepreload>) plus every chunk they reach through static imports and re-exports (`import … from`, `import "…"`, `export … from`; never `import()`). The view path is that walk from every root but the compiler; `compiler` and what it reaches are the rest. Two more walks feed only the forbidden-chunk check: the boot roots, the chunks of the `import()`s main.ts makes on every visit (./compiler.js, ./examples.js, ./samples.js, ./actions.js), each found among the built entry's dynamic imports; and the embed path, the walk from dist/embed.html's module script and modulepreloads, which also has its own budget. The `gzip` and `compilerGzip` numbers below were taken at P1 over the named files alone, before the walk existed; the growth gate compares the walked startup set against their sum.
viewBudgetWhy: PS-D5 (docs/plans/public-surfaces/README.md): startup JS without the compiler and the editor is at most 60 KB gzip. A hard ceiling on the view path's sum, not a growth allowance.
compilerPathBudgetWhy: card PG5a: the view path plus the compiler and everything both import statically. Measured 446,819 B on the PG5a branch (index 11,703 + panels 2,773 + preload-helper 798 + compiler 431,116 + rolldown-runtime 429); 575,197 B before it, when the compiler imported the jsPDF chunk (128,804 B). 458,000 B leaves 11,181 B (2.5 %) for ordinary core growth, stays under the ceiling the growth gate already set (438,980 + 20,000 = 458,980 B), and trips on any lazy heavyweight leaking in (glTF-Transform ~19,900 B, CodeMirror ~117,500 B, jsPDF ~129,800 B, three.js ~149,000 B). A hard ceiling like viewBudget: crossing it is a deliberate re-take with the reason in the commit.
embedPathBudgetWhy: card PG5a review: embed.html (the iframe other pages show) imports the core statically, so it walks into the compiler and once carried the same jsPDF leak (measured 565,245 B on main 7ad6fbf1, jsPDF's chunk 128,804 B of it). Measured 436,076 B on the PG5a branch (compiler 431,116 + panels 2,773 + embed 1,281 + one-room 477 + rolldown-runtime 429). 447,000 B leaves 10,924 B (2.5 %) for ordinary core growth, the same headroom as compilerPathBudget, and trips on any lazy heavyweight leaking in (the smallest, glTF-Transform, is ~19,900 B). A hard ceiling: crossing it is a deliberate re-take with the reason in the commit.
growthBudgetWhy: card A8: the 3D chunk is ~150,500 B gzip, so +20,000 B over the sum of every startup chunk (view path and compiler) trips on a leak of an eighth of it, while ordinary core growth (A5's own PR: +299 B) takes dozens of PRs to reach it; see preview3d.spec.ts
